test_randomize_ids_for_mephisto: test _randomize_ids_for_mephisto to generate new randomized primary keys for Mephisto database dump tables
test_randomize_ids_for_provider: test _randomize_ids_for_provider to randomize primary keys and update foreign keys in provider-specific database dumps
test_randomize_ids_full: test randomize_ids to randomize all primary keys across Mephisto and provider database dumps in one call
test_get_old_pk_from_substitutions: test get_old_pk_from_substitutions to look up the original primary key from a randomized substitution mapping
test_randomize_ids_legacy_only: test _randomize_ids_for_mephisto with legacy_only flag to only randomize IDs below the SQLite minimum threshold
